messages:
incident-bot: Paging: high 5xx rate observed for inference-api (prod, us-east-1). Alerts started at ~2026-03-15T21:36:29Z. Error rate spike ~18% over baseline. Trigger: error_rate>10% for 3m. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alarms/2123456789

alex (oncall): on it. I'm going to pull logs and check rollout history. Starting mitigation runbook (scale + fallback).

sam (eng): saw a surge of malformed protobufs hitting the ingress LB, looks like a bad client spike + an autoscaler race. Repro in logs: `x-client-proto: v2|null` repeated. Will add a temporary filter at the edge.

alex (oncall): ok applying edge filter now. Also spinning up 2 spare dedicated workers in us-east to drain queue. ETA ~4m.

ops-lead: FYI — we should prepare a short status page update and customer notification draft once we confirm impact window. Keep it factual: start time, mitigation steps, current state, and next steps.

statusbot: Proposed status page entry (draft):
```
Incident: Elevated error rate for inference-api in us-east-1
Status: Investigating -> Partial Service Degradation
Start: 2026-03-15T21:36:29Z
Summary: Some customers experienced increased 5xx responses for generation requests. We are rate-limiting malformed client payloads and scaling additional workers to restore normal traffic. No data loss reported.
Impact: Increased error rates and higher latency for a subset of requests in the region.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when mitigation completes.
```

maya (ops): edge filter applied at 21:40:10Z, autoscaler added workers at 21:41:05Z. Error rate dropped below 5% at 22:04:12Z and back to baseline by 22:07:00Z. Rough impact window: 21:36:29Z -> 22:07:00Z (~30.5 minutes).

alex (oncall): mitigation verified. Rolling back temporary filter at 22:10:00Z after regression testing. No further spikes observed.

jordan (billing): tagging this for compensation review. Need answers for: affected customers list (approx), exact start/end, classification (outage vs degradation), and which SLAs might apply. Please also include token/compute units impacted if possible.

maya (ops): quick counts: ~12,200 failed generated requests across 83 tenant IDs during window. Majority were retries from a single integration (tenant-981). We'll attach the per-tenant breakdown to the ticket. Approx extra compute time consumed due to retries: 6.8 GPU-minutes.

jordan (billing): thanks. For eligibility we use the standard policy: credits are considered for incidents that cause service unavailability or partial degradation exceeding the SLA threshold. For Hosted API customers: tiered credit formula applies (doc: /policies/sla-credits). Will need per-tenant monthly usage to compute pro-rata.

ops-lead: can we draft an internal recommendation and a customer-facing credit notice now? Keeps the customer comms short and nontechnical. Here's a suggested template we can use and tweak:

```
Customer notification (suggested):
Hi <customer-name>,

We wanted to let you know about a partial degradation of the inference API in the us-east-1 region on 2026-03-15 from 21:36:29Z to 22:07:00Z. During this period some generation requests returned 5xx errors. We have mitigated the issue and normal service was restored.

We’re investigating root cause and will follow up with additional details. If you experienced any degraded behavior, you may be eligible for a service credit per our SLA. Our billing team will reach out with next steps if a credit is applicable.

Apologies for the disruption — team Redwood
```

alex (oncall): minor note — please don't promise specific credits in the initial notice; say "may be eligible" like above. Also include link to status page in the message.

jordan (billing): agreed. I'll start the eligibility calc. For a preliminary assessment I need a CSV of per-tenant failed request counts + their monthly billable token counts. Maya/Sam can you drop that into the ticket? Tag: billing/sla-review.

sam (eng): uploading `incident-2123456789-failures.csv` to the incident ticket with columns: tenant_id, failed_requests, start_ts, end_ts, retry_count, estimated_gpu_minutes.

maya (ops): uploaded. Quick example row: `tenant-981, 8205, 2026-03-15T21:36:40Z, 2026-03-15T21:59:12Z, 3, 4.1`.

jordan (billing): preliminary policy mapping: since this is a partial degradation <1 hour and impacted <5% of total platform requests for the month, we generally offer pro-rata credits rather than full-month adjustments. I'll compute per-tenant credit as:
```
credit_amount = (impact_window_minutes / customer_billing_period_minutes) * monthly_amount_for_affected_service * severity_multiplier

Severity multiplier guidance: partial-degradation => 0.25, full-outage => 1.0 (will confirm in policy doc).
```

ops-lead: please surface any tenants with >25% of their requests failed — those get priority outreach.

jordan (billing): running the numbers now. Early estimate: ~12 tenants exceed our internal threshold for manual review; most tenants will get an automated credit offer via billing portal.

alex (oncall): for the handoff to postmortem and customer comms: I'll seed the incident ticket with timeline, actions taken, logs pointers, and the guardrail we added to the ingress. Also assigning to sam for root cause follow-up and to maya for impact analytics.

statusbot: Status page updated to Partial Degradation at 21:46Z, then to Monitoring at 22:10Z. Public note posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2123456789 (live).

maya (ops): follow-up tasks: 1) customer list + per-tenant impact (done), 2) alert tuning to avoid noisy malformed protobuf spikes, 3) add autoscaler cooldown so we don't trigger scalebombs, 4) schedule RCA.

sam (eng): will file RCA PR with logs and recommended fix (strict proto validation at LB) — target draft by EOD tomorrow.

jordan (billing): I'll post the billing-sla-review summary in the ticket by EOD and kick off credit runs for eligible tenants. Will coordinate communications with CS for manual outreach where needed.

alex (oncall): thanks all. Closing on-call thread — please keep updates in the incident ticket. If billing or CS need further details ping me directly. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved: service restored and mitigation removed. Final impact window recorded: 2026-03-15T21:36:29Z - 2026-03-15T22:07:00Z.

statusbot: Final public update posted: "Service restored. We are issuing follow-up communications to affected customers and evaluating eligibility for credits."
